sourceTitle: Colour as a Means of Art Being an Adaption of the Experience of Professors to the Practice of Amateurs
description: "Colour as a Means of Art" by Frank Howard is a detailed instructional guide on the principles of coloring in art, intended for amateurs and students of painting. Written in the mid-19th century, the book draws upon the experiences of various artistic masters to elucidate techniques that can aid in creating visually compelling artwork.
